79862834: Which Michael Jackson album is the best-selling in history?
Thriller (1982) is the best-selling album in history, with around 70 million copies, featuring “Billie Jean”, “Beat It” and the groundbreaking “Thriller” video.
097735ce: Which British band revolutionized pop music in the 1960s?
The Beatles (John Lennon, Paul McCartney, George Harrison and Ringo Starr) sold hundreds of millions of records and defined modern pop music.
7a2d76bc: Which 1980 AC/DC album is one of the best-selling in history?
AC/DC's Back in Black (1980) has sold around 50 million copies. It was their first album with Brian Johnson after Bon Scott's death, and its opening riff is one of the most recognizable in the world.
ff43b0cf: Which French rap duo is known for its cinematic music videos and poetic lyrics?
PNL (brothers N.O.S and Ademo) is known for its unique aesthetic: videos such as “Au DD”, “Que la famille” and “Mowgli” are true cinematic works blending trap and poetry.
58bdf7ec: Which 2016 Beyoncé album comes with a feature-length visual film?
Beyoncé's Lemonade (2016) comes with an hour-long film aired on HBO, exploring infidelity, Black identity and feminism.
e81ec031: Which 1994 Nas album is often cited as the greatest rap album of all time?
Nas's Illmatic (1994): 10 tracks in under 40 minutes depicting life in Queensbridge with absolute poetic mastery. It is widely cited as one of the peaks of the genre.
0d94ee89: Which Marseille rapper releases endless volumes of music and holds streaming records?
Jul is the most prolific artist in French rap: he releases an astronomical number of tracks every year and holds streaming records in France. His style mixes melodies, street lyrics and good humor.
c25a42dd: Which rock band released The Dark Side of the Moon in 1973?
The Dark Side of the Moon (1973) stayed on the Billboard 200 for more than 900 weeks, a record. It includes “Money” and “Time”.
c616e296: What is Aya Nakamura's real name?
Aya Nakamura is her real name
Aya Nakamura's real name is Aya Danioko. Born in Bamako, she grew up in Aulnay-sous-Bois and took her stage name from a character in the series Heroes.
41774913: Which French rapper is nicknamed “Le Duc de Boulogne”?
Booba (Élie Yaffa), from Boulogne-Billancourt, is nicknamed the “Duke of Boulogne”. He emerged in the 1990s with the duo Lunatic and has left a lasting mark on French rap.
cbc0ac4a: Which metal festival takes place in Clisson every summer in France?
Hellfest, in Clisson (Loire-Atlantique), is France's biggest metal festival. It hosts the genre's biggest names every summer.
760b14c5: Which Canadian artist released “Blinding Lights”, a global hit in 2020?
The Weeknd (Abel Tesfaye): “Blinding Lights” broke chart records around the world and became one of the most streamed singles in history.
62e582b3: Which rapper is often called the best living lyricist, thanks to To Pimp a Butterfly?
Kendrick Lamar is widely recognized as one of the best lyricists of his generation: To Pimp a Butterfly (2015) and DAMN. (2017, Pulitzer Prize) confirm his unique mastery.
97756b2c: Which rapper from Sevran released the album Réelle Vie?
Maes, a rapper from Sevran, made his name with Réelle Vie and then Les Derniers Salopards.
98fd9393: Which rapper from Caen released the album Civilisation in 2021?
Orelsan, from Caen, released Civilisation in 2021, which won at the Victoires de la Musique. “L'odeur de l'essence” is one of its standout tracks.
7b8ff7a9: Ipséité (2017) is Damso's second album. It includes “Macarena” and was praised for its introspection.
d813e798: Which rap group from Seine-Saint-Denis was formed by JoeyStarr and Kool Shen?
Suprême NTM, formed by JoeyStarr and Kool Shen, is, along with IAM, one of the founding groups of French rap. Paris sous les bombes is a cult album.
480111b2: What is the title of Adele's first studio album?
19 is Adele's first album (2008), released when she was 19, with “Chasing Pavements” and “Hometown Glory”. Its follow-up, 21 (2011), with “Rolling in the Deep”, made her a global superstar.
894ffdf5: Which live music event brought 72,000 people to Wembley in 1985?
The We Are the World concert

Live Aid (1985) was the benefit concert organized by Bob Geldof for Ethiopia, held simultaneously at Wembley (London) and JFK Stadium (Philadelphia), with Queen, U2, David Bowie and many other legends.
a8321e5a: What is the rapper SCH's real name?
SCH's real name is Julien Schwarzer. The Marseille rapper is behind A7, Anarchie and JVLIVS.
e355ad03: Which British band released “Bohemian Rhapsody” in 1975?
Queen's “Bohemian Rhapsody” (1975) is one of the most complex songs ever recorded: Freddie Mercury combined ballad, opera and hard rock in six minutes. The 2018 biopic revived it worldwide.
c2575832: Which Kendrick Lamar album won the Pulitzer Prize?
Kendrick Lamar's DAMN. (2017) won the 2018 Pulitzer Prize for Music, the first non-classical, non-jazz work to receive it. The album explores faith, fate and Black American identity.
db8faa26: What is the real name of the artist known as Drake?
Drake's real name is Aubrey Drake Graham. Born in Toronto in 1986, he started out as an actor on Degrassi before becoming one of the most listened-to rappers in the world.
3dc1a774: What is the real name of the artist known as Stromae?

Paul Van Haver is Stromae's real name, a Belgian-Rwandan artist born in Brussels. “Stromae” is “maestro” in verlan (French back slang). His albums Cheese, Racine Carrée and Multitude made him a global artist.
3db95661: Which Stromae album includes the hits “Alors on danse” and “Te quiero”?
Cheese (2010) is Stromae's first album. It includes “Alors on danse”, which topped the charts in many European countries and launched his international career.
b66ac001: What is the title of Stromae's 2013 album with “Formidable” and “Papaoutai”?
Racine Carrée (2013) is Stromae's best-selling album, with “Formidable”, “Papaoutai” (about an absent father), “Tous les mêmes” and “Ta fête”. It broke sales records across French-speaking Europe.
aa08e30c: Which French band of the 2000s released “Je veux te voir” and Safari Disco Club?
Yelle is a French electropop band fronted by singer Julie Budet. “Je veux te voir” (2006) made their name, and Safari Disco Club (2011) brought them success abroad.
feb1eb5f: Which eco-friendly festival takes place every year in the Bois de Vincennes in Paris?
We Love Green, created in 2011, takes place in the Bois de Vincennes. It focuses on the environment and hosts rap, pop and electronic headliners.
5bc7636c: Which singer is often described as the best-selling recording artist in France?
Johnny Hallyday reportedly sold more than 100 million records during his career. “Allumer le feu” and “Je te promets” are among his biggest hits.
45ce1f2a: Which French metal band from the Landes is famous around the world?
Gojira, formed in the Landes by the Duplantier brothers, is the best-known French metal band in the world. It performed at the opening ceremony of the Paris 2024 Olympics.
265dfdb6: What is the name of France's music awards ceremony, the equivalent of the Grammys?
The Victoires de la Musique are France's main music awards. Created in 1985, they honor artists in several categories: album, song, male and female artist, group or duo.
520285a2: Which 2019 PNL album confirmed the duo's unique status?
Deux Frères (2019) by PNL (N.O.S and Ademo) is their most acclaimed album and broke first-week records in France. Its melancholy urban aesthetic and atmospheric trap production are inimitable.
642232ba: Which French singer is known for “La Bohème” and “Avec le temps”?

Charles Aznavour is one of the absolute legends of French song. Born in Paris to Armenian parents, he sold more than 100 million records. “La Bohème” remains one of the best-known French songs in the world.
54c97b52: Which American band of the 1990s is known for “Smells Like Teen Spirit”?
Nirvana revolutionized rock with Nevermind (1991) and “Smells Like Teen Spirit”: Seattle grunge ended the 1980s glam metal era. Kurt Cobain, Dave Grohl and Krist Novoselic marked a generation.
3f7faf6a: Which French singer is known for “Non, je ne regrette rien”?
Édith Piaf is often called the greatest French singer of all time: “La Vie en rose”, “Non, je ne regrette rien” and “L'Hymne à l'amour” are her most iconic songs.
aba0023d: Which American rapper is known for the 1996 double album All Eyez on Me?
2Pac's All Eyez on Me (1996) is one of the best-selling rap albums, a double album released a few months before his murder. “California Love” and “How Do U Want It” are among its best tracks.
9b05fa7c: Which body in France plays the role of the American Billboard charts for measuring music sales?
The SNEP (Syndicat National de l'Édition Phonographique) compiles France's official sales charts, the equivalent of Billboard. It also certifies gold, platinum and diamond records.
4b205ea0: Which French electronic duo performed hidden under robot helmets?

Daft Punk, Thomas Bangalter and Guy-Manuel de Homem-Christo, is the iconic Parisian electronic duo. “Harder, Better, Faster, Stronger”, “Get Lucky” and “Around the World” are among their best-known hits.
fb7a8950: Which 1997 Daft Punk album revolutionized house music?
Homework (1997) is Daft Punk's first album, with “Da Funk”, “Around the World” and “Burnin'”. It defined the French Touch and its filtered house sound, which influenced electronic music worldwide.
630658cd: What is the name of the French alternative rock band known for “Le vent nous portera”?
Noir Désir, from Bordeaux, is one of the most important French rock bands. “Le vent nous portera”, “Tostaky” and “Un jour en France” are among its signature songs.
b035361b: What is the name of the note that lasts 4 beats in classical music?
The whole note lasts 4 beats, the longest common note value. The half note lasts 2 beats, the quarter note 1 and the eighth note half a beat.
45f35358: In which country was reggae born?
Reggae was born in Jamaica in the 1960s, growing out of ska and rocksteady. Bob Marley is its global ambassador, with albums such as Exodus and Rastaman Vibration and the compilation Legend.
6c145d50: Which K-pop group dominated the global charts with “Butter” and “Dynamite”?
BTS (Bangtan Boys) is the most popular K-pop group in the world: “Butter”, “Dynamite” and “Boy With Luv” topped charts worldwide. Their fandom, ARMY, is one of the most active in music.
0c469f38: Which musical genre is the signature of Nashville's music scene?

Nashville, Tennessee, is the world capital of country music. Taylor Swift, Dolly Parton, Johnny Cash and many others started their careers there. The Grand Ole Opry is the genre's most prestigious stage.
00c052df: Which Nigerian singer won the 2021 Grammy for Best Global Music Album with Twice as Tall?
Burna Boy won the Grammy for Best Global Music Album in 2021 with Twice as Tall. He is one of the leading figures of Afrobeats.
dbf70604: Which American awards are the equivalent of the Victoires de la Musique?
The Grammy Awards, presented by the Recording Academy since 1959, are the most prestigious American music awards.
a9f57503: Who directed Michael Jackson's “Thriller” music video?
John Landis (director of An American Werewolf in London) directed the “Thriller” video (1983): a 14-minute short film with transformation effects that redefined the music video.
25837c46: Which 2010 Kanye West album includes “Power” and “Runaway”?
My Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy (2010) is widely cited as Kanye West's masterpiece, a dense and ambitious album that pushed hip-hop's limits with “Power”, “All of the Lights” and “Runaway”.
9219572a: Which dance style is associated with 1990s trance and electronic music?
The shuffle (Melbourne Shuffle) is the dance associated with trance and electro house in the 1990s and 2000s. Born in Melbourne, Australia, it features fast, gliding footwork.
5f746f48: Which artist popularized “La Bamba” in 1958 and died young in a plane crash?

Ritchie Valens popularized “La Bamba” in 1958 with his rock version. He died in the plane crash of February 3, 1959, “the Day the Music Died”, with Buddy Holly and the Big Bopper. Los Lobos's version dates from 1987.
5ef7d6e0: Which artist is known for popularizing vaporwave as an internet music genre?
Macintosh Plus (Vektroid / Ramona Xavier) popularized vaporwave with Floral Shoppe (2011), a nostalgic internet genre built on slowed-down 80s and 90s samples with a retro consumerist aesthetic.
84904e99: Which French producer co-produced “Black Skinhead” on Kanye West's Yeezus?
Gesaffelstein (Mike Lévy) co-produced several tracks on Yeezus (2013), including “Black Skinhead”. Dark electronic music is his signature.
9bb29611: Which singer is known for “Rolling in the Deep” and released an album named after her age, 25?
Adele released 25 (2015) with “Hello” and “When We Were Young”. Her previous album, 21 (2011), includes “Rolling in the Deep” and “Someone Like You”. Her albums are named after her age.
580314d1: Which English rock band is known for “Don't Look Back in Anger” and “Wonderwall”?

Oasis (Liam and Noel Gallagher) is the most iconic Britpop band: “Wonderwall”, “Don't Look Back in Anger” and “Champagne Supernova” are their hits. The brothers' rivalry is part of British rock history.
2f54ce31: Which Rosalía album fused traditional flamenco with modern production?
El Mal Querer (2018) blends flamenco and modern production. This concept album is inspired by a 13th-century Occitan novel and won Rosalía several Latin Grammys.
80056031: What is the real name of the American rapper known as 50 Cent?
Curtis James Jackson III is 50 Cent's real name. The Queens rapper survived being shot nine times before releasing Get Rich or Die Tryin' (2003), produced with Dr. Dre and Eminem.
365e31fa: Which British rock band is known for “Stairway to Heaven”?

Led Zeppelin released “Stairway to Heaven” on their untitled fourth album (1971), one of the most played rock songs on radio for over 50 years. Robert Plant, Jimmy Page, John Paul Jones and John Bonham formed the legendary quartet.
9f5a29ba: Which Paris label, founded by Pedro Winter, launched the duo Justice?
Ed Banger Records, founded in 2003 by Pedro Winter (Busy P), launched Justice, SebastiAn and Breakbot.
618074c5: Which Brazilian artist is considered the father of bossa nova?

João Gilberto is the father of bossa nova, a genre fusing Brazilian samba with American jazz harmony. “The Girl from Ipanema” (with Stan Getz and Astrud Gilberto) is the best-known Brazilian song in the world.
605d6efb: Which rapper from Aulnay-sous-Bois is known for his offbeat humor and the album Xeu?
Vald, from Aulnay-sous-Bois, made his name with absurd humor and offbeat lyrics, notably on Agartha and Xeu.
70c1611a: Which Amy Winehouse album, released in 2006, made her world-famous?
Back to Black (2006) is Amy Winehouse's signature album, with “Rehab”, “Tears Dry on Their Own” and “Back to Black”. It won her 5 Grammy Awards in 2008. She died in 2011 at 27.
739b30a7: Which Caribbean musical genre combines African and European elements?
Zouk is a genre from the French Antilles (Martinique, Guadeloupe), developed by the band Kassav' in the 1980s. It blends African elements, biguine and Caribbean influences.
13caf9b4: Which singer is nicknamed the “King of Pop”?
Michael Jackson is nicknamed the “King of Pop”. Elvis Presley is “the King” of rock 'n' roll.
d1a430ab: Which singer released “Like a Virgin” in 1984?
“Like a Virgin” made Madonna a global star. She is nicknamed the “Queen of Pop”.
671d90e2: Purple Rain (1984) is an album, a song and a film by Prince.
853a6877: Which Quebec singer performs “My Heart Will Go On”, the theme from Titanic?
The song won the Oscar for Best Original Song in 1998 and became one of the best-selling singles in history.
8f82d78a: Which Swedish group won Eurovision 1974 with “Waterloo”?
ABBA won Eurovision in 1974 in Brighton, before becoming one of the best-selling groups in the world.
da28e32e: Which French singer wrote and performed “La Mer”?
Charles Trenet, nicknamed “le fou chantant” (the singing madman), recorded “La Mer” in 1946. It has been covered worldwide, notably as “Beyond the Sea”.
2845d1ef: Which Belgian singer wrote “Ne me quitte pas”?
Jacques Brel wrote and recorded “Ne me quitte pas” in 1959. It is one of the most covered French-language songs.
f575cf55: Which Jamaican singer performs “No Woman, No Cry”?
Bob Marley, with the Wailers, spread reggae around the world. He died in 1981, at 36.
28dac67d: Which guitarist played an electric version of the American national anthem at Woodstock in 1969?
Jimi Hendrix closed the festival with his distorted version of “The Star-Spangled Banner”, which became legendary.
f05a4bbe: Who was the lead singer of Queen?
Freddie Mercury, born in Zanzibar, was the voice of Queen. Brian May is the band's guitarist.
b04fca65: Which British band released the song “Yellow” in 2000?
“Yellow”, from the album Parachutes, brought Coldplay to a wide audience.
52b99f16: Which American singer released “Bad Guy” in 2019?
Billie Eilish co-writes her songs with her brother Finneas. “Bad Guy” earned her several Grammy Awards.
43ac8240: Which singer performed “L'Hymne à l'amour” on the Eiffel Tower at the Paris 2024 opening ceremony?
For her return to the stage, Céline Dion sang Édith Piaf's song from the Eiffel Tower. Lady Gaga and Aya Nakamura also performed during the ceremony.
9a65ed74: In which city was jazz born, in the early 20th century?
Jazz was born in New Orleans, Louisiana, from a mix of blues, ragtime and brass bands.
6d2ee54e: Which 1969 festival drew nearly half a million people in New York State?
The Woodstock festival, in August 1969, became the symbol of the hippie movement.
e07a1a07: In what year was the Fête de la Musique created in France?
Launched by Culture Minister Jack Lang, the Fête de la Musique has been held every June 21 since 1982.
3c9c2ead: Which European song contest has existed since 1956?
The first Eurovision Song Contest was held in Lugano, Switzerland, in 1956.
15609df5: Which composer wrote the music of the “Ode to Joy”, now the European anthem?
The “Ode to Joy” comes from Beethoven's Ninth Symphony (1824). It has been the anthem of Europe since 1985.
3ab08791: Which instrument did Miles Davis play?
Miles Davis, a trumpeter, led several revolutions in jazz. Kind of Blue (1959) is the best-selling jazz album.
6db580c9: Which instrument did the jazzman Charlie Parker play?
Charlie “Bird” Parker was one of the creators of bebop in the 1940s.
ddcdef0d: Which band released the album Abbey Road in 1969?
The cover shows the four Beatles crossing a zebra crossing outside the Abbey Road studios in London.
36c2fca2: Which band released A Night at the Opera (1975), which includes “Bohemian Rhapsody”?
This Queen album takes its title from a Marx Brothers film.
f25915ed: Which band released the album OK Computer in 1997?
Radiohead's OK Computer, with “Paranoid Android” and “Karma Police”, is regularly cited among the best albums of the 1990s.
369849cf: Which band released the album The Wall in 1979?
The Wall includes “Another Brick in the Wall”. It was adapted for the screen by Alan Parker in 1982.
083088df: Which duo released the album Random Access Memories (2013), with “Get Lucky”?
The album won the Grammy for Album of the Year in 2014. “Get Lucky” is sung by Pharrell Williams.
c4d11c3d: Which Marseille rapper is one of the founders of the group IAM?
Akhenaton, with Shurik'n and their companions, founded IAM. The album L'École du micro d'argent (1997) is a classic.
e7420d14: Which city do the brothers Bigflo & Oli come from?
Bigflo & Oli, two brothers from Toulouse, made their name with the album La Cour des grands (2015).
6e693a26: Which rapper released the album Feu in 2015?
Feu is the first solo album by Nekfeu, a member of the groups 1995 and S-Crew.
3b8e26ae: Which rapper released the album Destin in 2019?
Ninho's Destin includes “Lettre à une femme”. It was certified diamond.
